cases.name: equality with INCLUDE
cases.query: SELECT id, total FROM orders WHERE customer_id = $1

cases.name: unquoted identifiers fold to lower case
cases.query: SELECT Id FROM Orders WHERE OrderDate >= $1 AND Status = 'paid'

cases.name: quoted identifiers keep their case and stay quoted
cases.query: SELECT "Id" FROM public."Orders" WHERE "CustomerId" = 1

cases.name: LIKE followed by AND (parser precedence workaround)
cases.query: SELECT id FROM customers WHERE name LIKE 'Jo%' AND country = 'ID'

cases.name: NOT followed by AND (parser precedence workaround)
cases.query: SELECT id FROM orders WHERE NOT is_deleted AND customer_id = 5

cases.name: parenthesized NOT is left alone
cases.query: SELECT id FROM orders WHERE NOT (status = 'a' AND total > 5) AND customer_id = 5

cases.name: ILIKE cannot use a B-tree index
cases.query: SELECT id FROM customers WHERE email ILIKE 'a%'

cases.name: cast on the column is non-sargable
cases.query: SELECT id FROM orders WHERE order_date::date = $1

cases.name: function on the column is non-sargable
cases.query: SELECT id FROM customers WHERE lower(email) = $1

cases.name: join with ORDER BY DESC and LIMIT
cases.query: SELECT o.id, c.name FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE c.country = 'ID' ORDER BY o.order_date DESC LIMIT 20

cases.name: correlated EXISTS
cases.query: SELECT c.name FROM customers c WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM orders o WHERE o.customer_id = c.id AND o.status = 'open')

cases.name: IN subquery
cases.query: SELECT name FROM customers WHERE id IN (SELECT customer_id FROM orders WHERE total > 100)

cases.name: UPDATE
cases.query: UPDATE orders SET status = 'closed' WHERE customer_id = 3 AND order_date < $1

cases.name: DELETE
cases.query: DELETE FROM orders WHERE status = 'draft'

cases.name: CTE names are not tables
cases.query: WITH x AS (SELECT customer_id FROM orders WHERE status = 'a') SELECT customer_id FROM x WHERE customer_id = 1

cases.name: SELECT * disables covering
cases.query: SELECT * FROM orders WHERE customer_id = 1

cases.name: OR across columns
cases.query: SELECT id FROM orders WHERE status = 'a' OR customer_id = 1

cases.name: existing index covers the key
cases.query: SELECT customer_id FROM orders WHERE customer_id = 1

cases.name: existing index is widened in a transaction
cases.query: SELECT total FROM orders WHERE customer_id = 1

cases.name: primary-key lookup returns one row: covered
cases.query: SELECT name, country FROM customers WHERE id = $1

cases.name: unique-index lookup returns one row: covered
cases.query: SELECT name FROM customers WHERE email = $1

cases.name: a UNIQUE index is not dropped to widen it
cases.query: SELECT name FROM customers WHERE email > $1
